row_matching: transactions by normalized calendar date plus normalized description; blank debit or credit cells are the Excel-equivalent zero side of a typed transaction
identity_policy: candidate-defined non-empty unique transaction IDs; IDs must join Transactions to Provenance
category_policy: each transaction label must retain its business meaning; summary grouping and wording may differ from the oracle when every actual label is represented once by a formula-linked signed total
provenance_policy: correct statement filename and page plus a non-empty readable locator containing both; common page forms such as p.1, p1, page 1, and page:1 are accepted
